title: Milk and Fat for the Gods

title: Around the Fire at the Wedding

plan.english: Mother, why does the bride walk around the fire? Fire looks upon the bride and the husband, and he protects them both. Three times you will walk around him. Who will give me to my husband? Your father will give you, and the heavenly ones will see it. Will the gods give us children? May they give you many children and good fame. Are you afraid, my daughter? I am not afraid; the fire is warm.

title: We Give and They Give Back

plan.english: Father-in-law, why do we give our calves to the gods? We give to them, and they give back to us. We lead one calf to them, and ten come back to us. And if we give nothing? Then they give us nothing, and the herd is lost. Then I will give them my own calf. Good son-in-law, may the gods give you a hundred cows!

title: A Hungry Father in a Dream

plan.english: Of-Goodly-Fame, I caught sight of my dead father in a dream. What did he say to you? He said this: 'My child, I am hungry.' The dead are hungry when we do not remember them. Have you poured milk and fat for him this year? I have not poured anything for him. Then go to his gravestone and pour them out for him. I will go at dawn.
